modulation.passive_factors_in_rates: Yes. CAA: 'The 2027 due rates include the passive eco-modulation factors, as required by state law', applied automatically to invoices from supply data. Columns: Detriments Malus +5% (materials that disrupt recycling); Not on MRL Malus (AML at least 20% above the average of similar MRL materials; N/C at least 10% above similar AML); High Recycling Rate Bonus -5%. Examples in 2027: corrugated base 0.11 less 0.01 bonus = 0.10; steel 0.12 less 0.01 = 0.11; PP film base 0.65 + 0.04 Not-on-MRL malus = 0.69; plastic laminates 0.74 + 0.04 Detriments malus = 0.78; colored EPS cushioning 1.98 + 0.10 + 0.01 = 2.09; waxed corrugated 0.20 + 0.01 + 0.12 = 0.32.
modulation.active_bonuses: CAA's schedule says detailed Colorado eco-modulation guidance, including CDPHE bonus benchmarks that apply alongside the passive factors, would be posted by 2026-10-01. CAA's Colorado guidance page lists four incentive forms (PCR Content, Reuse/Refill, Reduction, Enhancement; published April 2026) and an Eco-Modulation Guidance revised October 2026, but the benchmark values and bonus amounts were NOT confirmed (guidance is in the login-only Producer Portal).
state_targets: C.R.S. 25-17-705(4)(p): minimum collection, recycling and PCR-content targets for paper, glass, metal and plastic by 2030-01-01 and 2035-01-01 (percentages set in the plan, not the statute)
Approved CAA plan (2025-12-10), per secondary sources: about 25% (2022) to 41% recycling in 2030 (Recycling Today); up to 60% of consumer packaging recycled by 2035 (Eco-Cycle)

notes: PRIMARY DOCUMENT VIA MIRROR: the CAA '2027 Colorado Producer Dues Schedule' (published 2026-10-01; 61 reporting categories) was read from a third-party copy at eprfeecheck.com because the official circularactionalliance.org link (linked from https://circularactionalliance.org/co-2027-producer-dues) redirects to a host that could not be opened. Every row SPI (secondary) also prints matches. rate_usd_per_lb is Final Dues (base + maluses - bonus). MRL = Minimum Recyclables List, AML = Additional Materials List, N/C = Not Collected. No reserve drawdown in Colorado. molded-pulp maps to plain 'Other Paper Packaging' (MRL, $0.15) because the only molded row, 'Other Paper Packaging - Molded Pulp Food Serviceware' (AML, $0.35), is for food serviceware (best-supported choice). eps-foam maps to white cushioning (AML, $1.90); colored foam cushioning is N/C at $2.09. Invoiced 50% January / 50% July 2027. Optional flat dues for 10 tons or less: $900 (1-2.5 t), $1,800 (2.5-5 t), $2,900 (5-7.5 t), $4,100 (7.5-10 t).
